video_title: Dave Burd Joins Friendsgiving Special 🦃 Takes on New Look Sixers, LeBron & All-Time NBA Top 10

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on his college basketball fandom and Villanova
quotes.excerpt: I related to you guys ever since I saw you at Villanova. I'm growing up in Philadelphia, just a fan.
quotes.quote: I related to you guys ever since I saw you at Villanova. I'm growing up in Philadelphia, just a fan, and that was my team as far as rooting for a college team. So thank you for those two national championships.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd argues Villanova is a Philadelphia school
quotes.excerpt: I consider it a Philly school. It's probably like 20 minutes outside of Philadelphia.
quotes.quote: I consider it a Philly school. It's probably like 20 minutes outside of Philadelphia. To me, if you grow up in Philly, the options that we had to root for were Temple, Saint Joe's, Villanova. Those are the three that come into my head as just a mainstream consumer.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on the unique Sixers-Villanova rivalry
quotes.excerpt: As a Sixers fan, you guys have created a unique circumstance where you're our bitter rivals.
quotes.quote: As a Sixers fan, you guys have created a unique circumstance where you're our bitter rivals, but honestly, all of us still kind of love you. It's kind of unique to have earned that. I think I DM'd you when you guys beat us last year, or two years ago, whenever you beat us. It seems as though every year in the playoffs, but it's hard to dislike you.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on Sixers fans' perception of Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: I just don't believe that they hate Jalen Brunson the way maybe they hate Jason Tatum.
quotes.quote: I just don't believe that they hate Jalen Brunson the way maybe they hate Jason Tatum. I hate to say it.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd recalls Mike Scott's incident with Philly fans
quotes.excerpt: You remember what they did to Mike Scott? This is my favorite story about Philly sports fans.
quotes.quote: You remember what they did to Mike Scott? This is my favorite story about Philly sports fans. Mike Scott, NBA player who was playing on the Sixers, but he's from DC. So while playing on the Sixers, he went to a game at Lincoln Financial Field wearing a, at the time, a Redskins jersey, now a Commanders jersey, and he got in a fight with Philly fans while being a Sixer.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on his disbelief about LeBron James joining the Sixers
quotes.excerpt: I still didn't think that LeBron James was coming to Philly.
quotes.quote: I still didn't think that LeBron James was coming to Philly. I mean, we were in his top three, but I still didn't think that LeBron James was coming to Philly.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd praises Josh Hart as a glue guy
quotes.excerpt: If we're talking about a guy who's got to be the glue guy doing all the dirty work.
quotes.quote: If we're talking about a guy who's got to be the glue guy doing all the dirty work, I don't know that there's a better glue guy, dirty work guy in the NBA. Maybe a V.J. Edgecombe, but I don't know. I love V.J. Edgecombe. I think when he's playing, he's our glue guy, and he happens to be a superstar at being a glue guy and doing everything.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on LeBron James's passing ability
quotes.excerpt: He's the best passer in the NBA at that. He's the best passer in the NBA.
quotes.quote: He's the best passer in the NBA at that. He's the best passer in the NBA, present day.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on the Sixers' ability to win close games
quotes.excerpt: It is really satisfying as a Sixers fan to see them win all these close games.
quotes.quote: It is really satisfying as a Sixers fan to see them win all these close games in ways that they previously would lose in years prior, and I give LeBron James a lot of credit for that, for getting the people in the right places and really giving them this sense of confidence.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on Joel Embiid's performance against Boston
quotes.excerpt: Look what he did to Boston last year. If Joel Embiid is feeling good at the right time.
quotes.quote: Look what he did to Boston last year. If Joel Embiid is feeling good at the right time, which really truly has never happened in the last eight years, in a situation where he's not injured, he's dominant.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on Anthony Simon's game
quotes.excerpt: I think Anthony Simons has the most beautiful game in the NBA.
quotes.quote: I think Anthony Simons has the most beautiful game in the NBA. When I watch Anthony Simons play, I'm like, that's gorgeous. It is gorgeous.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on his playing style compared to Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I play a lot like Stephen Curry. If I had one NBA comp, it's like Steph.
quotes.quote: I feel like I play a lot like Stephen Curry. If I had one NBA comp, it's like Steph. It's just, you know, kind of crafty. I'm going to get my shot whenever I want. Can't leave me. Really streaky. I'm obviously Steph is beyond streaky, but, you know, pick-up games go by up to 11 and I score 11 of the points.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on the Philadelphia sports culture
quotes.excerpt: Philadelphia is no longer a sports town. That was absurd. I disagree from the jump.
quotes.quote: Philadelphia is no longer a sports town. That was absurd. I disagree from the jump.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on the intensity of Sixers-Knicks playoff games
quotes.excerpt: Nothing is more annoying than watching a Knicks-Sixers playoff series in Philadelphia and it's just as loud.
quotes.quote: Nothing is more annoying than watching a Knicks-Sixers playoff series in Philadelphia and it's just as loud. If like almost it feels like someone is loud or something. It makes me so mad.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on the disposable income of sports fans
quotes.excerpt: It must be a disposable income thing. I really think that it must be.
quotes.quote: It must be a disposable income thing. I really think that it must be. I think that your Knicks team, if you guys went to Boston last year, you would have been shocked by how many Knicks, like I think that there are die-hard Knicks fans that have been just waiting to be die-hard Knicks fans for their whole lives, and now they can be.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on his belief in his own success
quotes.excerpt: Since I was like a kid, I felt destined to be a star and not just be like any old star.
quotes.quote: Since I was like a kid, I felt destined to be a star and not just be like any old star, like an elite star. It's kind of always how I felt. So I just didn't know if like the whole time you were like, I am going to be this. I know circumstances and teams and fits, but I worked to do that.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on his strategic approach to his music career
quotes.excerpt: I was so strategic about making sure I had like a huge inventory of music and videos.
quotes.quote: I was so strategic about making sure I had like a huge inventory of music and videos that I could put out. I thought if this first song succeeds, I'm not going to have nothing after that. I'm going to have this. So every week right after my first one, I had a new thing every week to put out for like five months straight.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on the importance of visual content for music
quotes.excerpt: Especially with my music, you really need like visual tie-ins.
quotes.quote: Especially with my music, you really need like visual tie-ins. You won't necessarily understand what's so funny about certain songs if you're not watching the right video to go along with it. So I have to be mindful of all that.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on his unique position as a rapper
quotes.excerpt: I didn't think that there were any rappers who were kind of talking about the stuff.
quotes.quote: I didn't think that there were any rappers who were kind of talking about the stuff. Like the first song was about me meeting my girlfriend's ex-boyfriend and like peeing next to him and like looking at his dick and he had like this huge dick and like feeling insecure. Like no other rappers are making songs about that. So I was like, I'm going to have an advantage because I'm really a unicorn in my lane. Like there's just zero competition as far as guys who are making music about that.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd on his admiration for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: First off, I was always initially like the biggest Kobe fan. He was like my favorite player ever.
quotes.quote: First off, I was always initially like the biggest Kobe fan. He was like my favorite player ever. And so maybe initially I might have even been kind of prone to be resistant to LeBron James, you know, because I've looked at him as Kobe's competition. But over the course of his career, I just don't know how you couldn't love this man. Like all he does is seemingly be a champion in every way. Like the amount of pressure he's had on him and to I feel like surpass the expectations, do it without ever like seemingly like pissing anyone off along the way, like everyone seems to like love him. I love him.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's top 10 players to guard
quotes.excerpt: I'm picking Stephen Curry. I got to have the persons you have to guard when he steps on the court.
quotes.quote: I'm picking Stephen Curry. I got to have the persons you have to guard when he steps on the court, no matter where he is on the court. That threat, even just him thinking, oh, he might be open, is scary for defenders. But then you have Magic Johnson who can make any pass and start any break. I prefer the shooting. I would put Larry Bird and Magic Johnson over Hakeem Olajuwon. I would put Kevin Durant and Dirk Nowitzki over Hakeem Olajuwon. I love Kevin Garnett. I love watching his media.

quotes.speaker: Dave Burd
quotes.summary_phrase: Dave Burd's top 10 players list
quotes.excerpt: I think that's I said Duncan already. I think it's Bird and Magic. And I think those are my top 10.
quotes.quote: There's obviously Larry Bird, Kevin Durant and Magic Johnson who maybe they would round out those 10. I would put Bird and Magic over Kareem Abdul-Jabbar. I think that's I said Duncan already. I think it's Bird and Magic. And I think those are my top 10 in no particular order. And then after you have Kevin Garnett, your Dirk Nowitzki, I love Kevin Garnett. I love him talking too. I love watching his media.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on winning the championship
quotes.excerpt: You won the championship. You did it. You guys are made men in New York City for life.
quotes.quote: You won the championship. You did it. You guys are made men in New York City for life. Everyone was waiting for the day that the Knicks won a championship and you did it. Was it as satisfying as you imagined it would be or deep down was it a little bit underwhelming and kind of like this is all there is to life?

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the championship parade
quotes.excerpt: It was not underwhelming at all. If anything, it was like the parade day was overwhelming.
quotes.quote: It was not underwhelming at all. If anything, it was like the parade day was overwhelming. I would say honestly for me, winning was like it was fun, it was cool. But then like once you did the parade, the parade was like, okay, yeah, this is this is like the moment. And then after that I left. I went on vacation because this is hectic.
